critique: The note proves an exact two-sided characterization of the equilibrium-response set, including constructive attainment and countermodels, rather than merely an outer bound. Its principal scope limitation is that the characterization concerns the source-minimal irreducible fixed-law fiber, not Dai et al.'s larger graphically irreducible completion family. The output-optimal enumeration result is conditional on receiving an exact mixing representative and does not provide an end-to-end recovery complexity bound. The root-N confidence result applies only to the quantitatively separated common-order iid class, so it does not establish inference for the dependent HSI series or for the qualitative heterogeneous-order class; the framing accurately keeps those extensions outside the proved claims.
